errors.title: Connection needs attention

errors.handshake_timeout: The handshake timed out. The game server did not complete the connection in time.
errors.heartbeat_timeout: The heartbeat timed out. The game server may be unresponsive; reconnection will be attempted.

errors.server_error: The game server reported an error.
errors.server_busy: Another client is already connected to the game server. Disconnect it before trying again.
errors.invalid_frame: The game server rejected the message format or size.
errors.invalid_json: The game server rejected the JSON data or field types.
errors.invalid_message: The game server rejected the message ID or type.
errors.unsupported_version: The game server does not support this protocol version.
errors.handshake_required: The game server requires a new handshake.

errors.already_connected: The game server reported a duplicate handshake.
errors.unknown_type: The game server does not support this message type.
errors.ui_unavailable: The plugin could not be reached. Check that it is running, then try again.
errors.ui_action_missing: The connection action is not registered. Refresh the plugin list and restart the NekoSous plugin, then try again.
errors.plugin_not_running: NekoSous is not running. Start it in the plugin manager first.
errors.subscription_timeout: Subscription confirmation timed out. The client will reconnect to synchronize its state.
errors.announcement_failed: The game announcement could not be submitted to N.E.K.O. The connection is still available; check the plugin logs.

broadcast.cue:
A fresh Overcooked! 2 game event: {facts}
As {LANLAN_NAME}, briefly tell {MASTER_NAME} what happened or offer encouragement in one or two natural sentences. Use only these facts. Do not invent recipes, level names, or stars, and do not claim to control a chef. Keep countdown reminders short and do not recap previous events.

broadcast.firstDelivery: The first valid order of this round was delivered successfully
broadcast.comboBroken: The order was delivered successfully, but it did not continue the combo. The previous combo and tip bonus have reset; this was not a failed delivery
broadcast.deliveryStreak: Successfully delivered {count} consecutive orders without a rejected delivery or order timeout during this streak
broadcast.failedDelivery: There were {count} recent deliveries that did not match a valid order; the specific cause is unknown
broadcast.expiredOrder: There were {count} recent order timeouts; the same order may reset its timer and expire again
broadcast.orderCue:
A confirmed Overcooked! 2 order event: {facts}.
As {LANLAN_NAME}, briefly respond to {MASTER_NAME} in one natural sentence. Offer light praise for deliveries or a gentle reminder or reassurance for failures and timeouts, without blame. Use only these facts. Do not invent recipe names, failure causes, player identities, cookware, or screen contents. Do not confuse rejected deliveries with order timeouts or treat timeout counts as distinct order counts. Do not claim to control a chef.
broadcast.chatChange: Score change since the previous cue: {change}
broadcast.chatCue:
An Overcooked! 2 round is in progress. Known facts: {facts}.
This is a quiet moment for company. As {LANLAN_NAME}, casually say something to {MASTER_NAME}, offer light encouragement, or respond to progress in one or two sentences. Vary your phrasing and do not mechanically read every number. Do not infer deliveries, missed orders, mistakes, fire, or anything visible on screen. Do not claim to control a chef. An unchanged score does not mean the player is stuck.
settings.fireHint: React to new fires before delivery praise. Nearby-in-time events are grouped.
settings.readyHint: React when food is ready. Pending reminders are cleared after removal from heat or overcooking.
settings.overcookingHint: React to the game's overcooking warning, including the final seconds.
settings.upgradeKitchen: Update the game-side NekoSous plugin to use kitchen event switches.
settings.mixing_readyHint: React when mixing finishes. Pending reminders clear after removal or overmixing warnings.
settings.mixing_warningHint: Prompt removal when overmixing is approaching. The food is still usable at this stage.
settings.mixing_ruinedHint: React when overmixing has actually ruined the food. Emptying and restarting allows a new cycle.
settings.upgradeMixing: Update the game-side NekoSous plugin to use mixing event switches.
broadcast.mixing_ready: {count} food items just finished mixing and can be removed
broadcast.mixing_warning: {count} food items just entered the overmixing warning; remove them soon, as they are not ruined yet
broadcast.mixing_ruined: {count} food items just became unusable from overmixing and need to be discarded and remade
broadcast.fire: {count} objects just caught fire; the fire needs attention
broadcast.ready: {count} heated food items just finished cooking and can be removed
broadcast.overcooking: {count} food items just entered the overcooking warning and risk burning if left heating
broadcast.kitchenCue:
Confirmed Overcooked! 2 kitchen event: {facts}.
As {LANLAN_NAME}, give {MASTER_NAME} one brief, natural reminder. Promptly call attention to fire, overcooking, or approaching overmixing; casually mention completed food and gently suggest remaking food that is actually ruined. Distinguish mixing from cooking and a warning from ruined food. Do not guess dish names, locations, seconds remaining, or player identity. Do not blame anyone or claim to control the game. Keep grouped events in one reminder.
settings.deliveryHint: Always react to the first delivery and streaks of 3, 6, 10, then every 4 orders.
settings.expiryHint: Announce every expired order, including the final seconds.
settings.failureHint: React when a delivered dish matches no order.
settings.comboHint: React when a valid delivery resets the combo and tip multiplier.
